description: This file defines a controller class `CustomerApproval` for the Admin module of the OpenCart platform. It manages customer approval workflows, including listing, approving, and denying customer approval requests, with methods to handle these actions and generate corresponding views and JSON responses.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing customer approval requests, including listing, approval, and denial functionalities within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the customer approval list page, initializes breadcrumb navigation, filters, pagination, and fetches approval data to render the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve the filtered list of customer approvals and outputs the data in JSON format.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the customer approval list table based on current filters and pagination, used by the index method.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to approve selected customer approvals, verifying permissions, updating records, and returning success or error in JSON.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to deny selected customer approvals, verifying permissions, updating records, and returning success or error in JSON.
